region.

subsidiary of KPIT Technologies Limited (•KPIT India•), as per applicable laws &
provisions of United Kingdom.

UK") and further KPIT UK is a wholly owned subsidiary of KPIT India. The
Operations, Employees & Customer contracts of Somit UK have been fully
integrated into KPIT UK. This strike-off will reduce the multiplicity of existing
legal & regulatory compliances, administration and its cost. Please note that
this strike-off of SOMIT UK will not affect any business & will not have any
impact on the financial reporting or operations.
